plan.goal: Size the PLINK binary .bed storage for a GWAS genotype dataset of 8142 samples and 3630638 variants (974773 on the largest chromosome), reporting total .bed size, per-chromosome .bed size, and number of per-chromosome files.
plan.rationale: PLINK binary .bed packs 2 bits per sample per variant, so size = n_samples × n_variants / 4 / 1e6 MB. The total dataset has 8142 samples and 3630638 variants; the largest chromosome carries 974773 variants. Per-chromosome files are split by chromosome; with 22 autosomes plus X, Y and MT this is 25 files, assuming all chromosomes are present and none are merged. The per-chromosome .bed size is computed for the largest chromosome (974773 variants); other chromosomes scale proportionally with their own variant counts.
caveats: The number of per-chromosome files (25) assumes all 22 autosomes plus X, Y and MT are present and split individually; confirm the actual chromosome set in the dataset.
The per-chromosome .bed size (≈1984 MB) is for the largest chromosome (974773 variants); other chromosomes will be proportionally smaller based on their own variant counts.
These are binary .bed sizes only; the .bim and .fam files add additional storage not included here.
